requiredFindings.title: Keep recognition payload bounds under an explicit override
requiredFindings.detail: Section 3 exempts recognition from the entry-point bound under an explicit override, while section 4 retains recognized results as disclosure. A unit with 65537 Next.js routes and explicit discovery.entryPoints: [] therefore retains an effects.entryPoints array with 65537 items. The configuration array is within its own maxItems, but the retained recognition violates FrameworkRecognitionResultV1.effects.entryPoints.maxItems=65536. The declared validation of every FrameworkRecognitionV1/UnitRecognitionV1 output cannot succeed. Explicit precedence does not waive bounds on retained recognition payloads.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Apply the bounded, non-truncating recognition disclosure policy even when an explicit override supplies the effective entry set. Keep effective entryPoints state/source all/explicit and the exact explicit list; distinguish those from suppressed discovered effects and their overflow disclosure. Add explicit-empty and explicit-nonempty controls with over-bound recognized entries, including an individual result over 65536 and the distinct union overflowing across results, and require schema-valid output.

requiredFindings.title: Represent actual resolver absence as no winning leaf
requiredFindings.detail: The rule says only a Defaulted leaf is absent. At the pinned product base, configuration.rs defaults_document (lines 927-980) emits analysis/components/policy only, with no discovery.entryPoints. resolve constructs provenance solely from winners (lines 596-599), so a configuration with no entryPoints carrier has neither that semantic field nor a discovery.entryPoints provenance entry. It does not have a Defaulted leaf. The proposed exhaustive distinction omits the ordinary automatic-mode input and risks requiring a fabricated default, contrary to the empty-fold and unchanged-digest requirements.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Specify no resolved entryPoints field/no winning provenance leaf as the current automatic-mode case. Preserve Carrier provenance as explicit even for []; define any Defaulted branch only if such an input is actually supported. Run the planned absent/empty/higher-empty controls using actual configuration::resolve outputs, and keep the absent configuration and digest unchanged.
